derived_from_verified_controls: height difference requires two actual accepted elevations
both elevations require candidate identity+coordinate binding
each elevation retains EA DTM lineage and survey epoch
horizontal transform and vertical datum errors remain separate
correlated EA products cannot be treated as independent
Terrain50 is coarse independent corroboration rather than a second high-resolution measure
no difference or confidence score is emitted until both real measurements pass all gates
quality_effect: Prevents a height-difference row from existing until two fully bound real elevations and their provenance are available.
